integrity: A closed-form polynomial in squared rare-block mass classifies the sign for every rate contrast and every nonnegative time. The proof uses exact compressed-Gram determinants and interpolation at two real Ritz values. A standard-library rational checker independently reproduces the determinant identity and a strict negative sign at time one; no finite enumeration is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic; a reducible symmetric four-state Markov generator consisting of two independent two-state links; a specified nonnegative start and ordinary two-step Lanczos exponential projection. No claim about all reversible generators, minimum state dimension, restart methods, irreducible chains, or finite precision.
title: Exact positivity phase diagram for two-step Lanczos propagation on two reversible Markov links
